T: Second star to the right. Snacks straight on.
D: A boy who never grows up takes Wendy and her brothers to Neverland to face Captain Hook.
P: Serve the snacks when the children fly over London.
S: the crocodile that swallowed a clock
Baguette slices toasted with olive oil, topped with smashed peas, mint and feta, the green ridges made with a fork.
Skull Rock gruyère and pepper puffs

Golden choux puffs loaded with gruyère and cracked black pepper, crisp outside and hollow inside, served warm from the oven. Boil 250ml water with 100g butter and a pinch of salt, tip in 150g plain flour and beat over the heat for 1 minute until it leaves the sides. Cool 5 minutes, then beat in 4 eggs one at a time until glossy. Stir in 120g grated gruyère and 1 tsp cracked pepper. Pipe 30 small balls onto lined trays, top with a little extra cheese and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and golden.
Prawns poached in salted water with lemon, chilled and served on ice with a cocktail sauce of mayo, tomato sauce and lemon.
M: Captain Hook's beef and allspice stew
Captain Hook's ship in the bay

Beef chuck simmered for hours with onions, carrots, allspice and a touch of molasses until thick and dark, with crusty bread. Toss 1kg diced beef chuck in 2 tbsp plain flour and brown in batches. Soften 2 sliced onions and 3 chopped carrots, then add the beef, 1 tsp ground allspice, 1 tbsp molasses or brown sugar, 1 tbsp tomato paste and 750ml beef stock. Cover and simmer gently for 3 hours until thick and tender. Season well and serve in big bowls with crusty bread.
the Lost Boys' hideout under the tree

Sticky drumsticks roasted in honey, paprika and garlic, with buttered corn cobs and crispy roast potatoes, all eaten with your hands. Toss 12 chicken drumsticks with 3 tbsp honey, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tbsp oil and salt. Roast at 200C for 40 minutes, turning once, until sticky and cooked through. Roast 1kg potato chunks tossed in oil alongside for 45 minutes. Boil 4 corn cobs for 6 minutes, cut in half and roll in butter. Pile everything onto one big board.
W: Tinker Bell and her pixie dust
White bread spread with butter and covered in hundreds and thousands, cut into triangles, dusted with a little edible glitter.
K: Nana the dog looking after the nursery

Warm milk whisked frothy with malt powder, honey and vanilla, topped with a cloud of cream and a dusting of nutmeg. Heat 1L milk in a saucepan until steaming but not boiling. Take off the heat and whisk in 4 tbsp malted milk powder, 2 tbsp honey and 1 tsp vanilla until frothy. Pour into 4 mugs. Whip 100ml cream to soft peaks and spoon a little on each, then grate over a little nutmeg. Serve with a plain biscuit on the side.

s.note: the crocodile that swallowed a clock
s.how: Slice a baguette and brush with olive oil, then toast until golden. Cook 300g peas, then smash with chopped mint, crumbled feta and a squeeze of lemon. Spread thickly on the toasts and run a fork along the top to make green crocodile ridges.

Bring a pot of salted water to the boil with lemon slices. Add 500g green prawns and poach for 2 minutes until pink, then plunge into iced water. Peel, leaving tails on, and serve on ice with a sauce of mayonnaise, tomato sauce, lemon and hot sauce.
